description: Land Title Settlement Department - Munagama (Block 01), Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530230
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. The notices specifically deal with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land parcels, and title settlement processes for various villages and districts. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registration, property ownership claims, and land title settlement matters.
